"The Prime Minister granted a reserved spot to Oren Dobronsky because he is a successful high-tech entrepreneur, philanthropist, and leading businessman who will bring his rich experience to developing Israel's economy, with a emphasis on the tech sector and advancing artificial intelligence in Israel," Likud said in a statement.

Kudos to the professional staff, owner Alona Barkat, the players, and the fans who accompanied and cheered on this fantastic team in Serbia as well. flash_691639.description:
The family of Mali and Liel Yahalomi, the Israeli mother and daughter missing in Vienna, is sharply criticizing recent publications and briefings by police and investigative officials.

In an official statement, the family clarified: "We view with utmost severity the briefings circulated in recent hours, which create the public impression that a conclusion has already been established regarding the circumstances of Mali and Liel's disappearance. The family possesses information that fundamentally contradicts several of the claims raised in these reports."

According to the family, the information provided to them by the police shows no unusual activity on the bank accounts of either woman: "We unequivocally clarify that at this stage, there is no basis for ruling out the possibility of a nationalistically motivated terrorist incident."

The Israel Airports Authority rejected reports of a staffing shortage at Ben Gurion International Airport, saying the delays were caused, among other factors, by heavy air traffic, restrictions in European airspace, and flights by American refueling aircraft.

According to the authority, an unusually large backlog of approximately 90 flights accumulated within three hours, while around 90,000 passengers are expected to pass through the airport today.

flash_691745.description:
More than 50 kilograms of drugs, estimated to be worth millions of shekels, were discovered yesterday during searches along Israel’s eastern border in the Jordan Valley area.

According to the IDF, the drugs were found in sacks by troops from the Lions of the Jordan Battalion and trackers from the Jordan Valley and Emekim Brigade. They were handed over to police for further investigation.

In recent months, security forces have foiled smuggling attempts involving more than 200 kilograms of drugs in the area.
